name: hmsi
description: Hospital Management System - Multi-platform (Web / Windows / Android), deployed on Netlify

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -k -c auto -n api,web "npm run dev -w @hmsi/api" "npm run dev -w @hmsi/web"
scripts.dev:local: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -k -c auto -n api,web "npm run dev:local -w @hmsi/api" "npm run dev -w @hmsi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w @hmsi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hmsi/api && npm run typecheck -w @hmsi/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test:smoke -w @hmsi/api
